title: C: add LOG_HEXDUMP on protocol parse failures
description: Protocol parsing errors in the C implementation log the errno/error code but never the actual bytes that failed to parse. No LOG_HEXDUMP_DBG usage found in sampled files. An AI diagnosing a parse failure cannot see whether the input was truncated, corrupted, or a valid frame from a newer protocol version. Fix: add LOG_HEXDUMP_DBG of the first N bytes (32-64) at key parse failure points in l2/lichen_l2_rx.c, schc, oscore_protect.c, and edhoc. Gate behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_HEXDUMP to avoid code-size impact in production.
